note: R15-3: model assets that are not runtime profiles. A loader reads the asset's bytes once, checks them against sha256 here and hands the loader exactly those bytes; an asset that is not registered, has an empty sha256 or does not match is refused (coverage failed "미고정 모델: <자산>"). Empty sha256 = no official digest published: pin a copy you trust with `deepfake-lens vendor-weights pin-asset <name>` (writes <models dir>/assets.json).
